answer_1.quote: MSJ manipulates LLMs by providing a sequence of harmful Question-Answer (QA) pairs before a target query. This attack exploits model capability to recognize and replicate patterns from multiple shots, compelling the model to generate harmful responses despite safety alignment.
answer_1.outputs: Responses to harmful and safe queries

answer_2.quote: In all experiments, we use ASR as our evaluation metric, rather than NLL used in previous studies.

answer_3.quote: To evaluate ASR, we compared several judge models including the Llama Guard (Llama Team, 2024), a fine-tuned version trained on our dataset, the OpenAI Moderation API (Ope-nAI, 2024b), and also explored using LLMs as judges including GPT-4o, Claude 3.5 Sonnet (Anthropic, 2024) and Gemini 1.5 Pro.
